body:
Keyboard navigation within search results usually means the actual links of the results. These are already available quite easily with tab if the search box and results are close together DOM-wise.

For real keyboard navigation, a combobox makes more sense for both sighted and non-sighted users, and for that we have autocomplete, which works together nicely with InstantSearch: https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/ui-and-ux-patterns/autocomplete/js/
